```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
```

## 1.读取数据

```{r}
prices <- read_csv("C:/Users/李沐霖/Documents/prices.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
fin <- read_csv("C:/Users/李沐霖/Documents/financials.csv",show_col_types=FALSE)

```

## 2.清洗数据&指标计算

### 计算每只股票在不同窗口的涨跌幅：近1周、近13周、近52周

```{r}
perf <- prices%>%
  mutate(data=as.Date(date))%>%
  arrange(company,date)%>%
  group_by(company)%>%
  mutate(
    ret_1w=close/lag(close,1)-1,
    ret_13w=close/lag(close,13)-1,
    ret_52w=close/lag(close,52)-1
  )%>%
  ungroup()

#取每个公司的最新一周作为”本周表现“概览
latest_week <- perf%>%
  slice_max(date,n=1,by=company)%>%
  select(company,ticker,sector,date,close,ret_1w,ret_13w,ret_52w)%>%
  mutate(across(c(ret_1w,ret_13w,ret_52w),~round(.x*100,2)))

```

## 3.可视化

### 图1：行业个股周度收盘价格走势

```{r}
plot_price_trend <- function(df=prices){
  df%>%
  mutate(date=as.Date(date))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=date,y=close,color=company))+
    geom_line(linewidth=0.7)+
    labs(title="行业代表公司周度收盘价走势",
         x="日期",y="收盘价（元）",color="公司")+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
plot_price_trend()

```

### 图2：近一年涨跌幅对比

```{r}
plot_return_bar <- function(df=latest_week){
  df%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=reorder(company,ret_52w),y=ret_52w,fill=ret_52w>0))+
    geom_col()+
    coord_flip()+
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("TRUE"="#E74C3C","FALSE"="#27AE60"))+
    labs(title="近一年涨跌幅对比(%)",
x="公司",y="涨跌幅(%)")+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(legend.position = "none")}
plot_return_bar()
```

### 图3：最新年度营收vs净利润

```{r}
plot_finance <- function(df = fin) {
  last_year <- max(df$year)
  df %>%
    filter(year == last_year) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(revenue, net_profit),
                 names_to = "指标", values_to = "金额") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = company, y = 金额, fill = 指标)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    labs(title = paste0(last_year, " 年营收与净利润对比（亿元）"),
         x = "公司", y = "金额（亿元）") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}
plot_finance()

```
